certification.name: Fellow of Information Privacy
certification.description: Designation awarded on application to holders of a CIPP plus a CIPM, CIPT or AIGP who document three years of privacy or data protection experience, a personal statement and three peer references. There is no exam; it stays active while the underlying certifications are maintained.
certification.currency_note: No exam; awarded on application. The page lists no separate fee once two IAPP credentials are held
